Car reaches 130mph along M5 during police chase

The vehicle lost two tyres during the pursuit

bristolpost
  • Bookmark
  • Share
  • Comments

Estel Farell RoigContent Editor

    A car reached speeds of 130mph along the M5 during a police chase overnight. Avon and Somerset Road Policing Unit said the vehicle was suspected to have been stolen and was displaying cloned registration plates.

    Writing on Facebook, police said the vehicle was first spotted travelling northbound on the M5.
